# LuxMV — Machine Vision Lighting, Optics, and Engineering Selection Guide

> LuxMV provides machine vision lighting, controllers, industrial lenses, cameras, optical accessories, sample-based lighting selection, and custom illumination discussions for industrial inspection projects. Final model, wavelength, dimensions, working distance, controller mode, mounting, documentation, quantity, and price must be confirmed through project-specific review.

## Core Entity

- Official site: https://www.luxmv.com
- Contact: info@luxmv.com
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/8613602667760
- Business focus: machine vision lighting and optical selection for industrial inspection.
- Selection method: start from the inspected material, defect, field of view, working distance, camera, lens, speed, trigger mode, mounting envelope, and sample evidence.

## Product Families

- [Ring lights](https://www.luxmv.com/machine-vision-lights/ring-lights): Front illumination and directional inspection discussions.
- [Bar lights](https://www.luxmv.com/machine-vision-lights/bar-lights): Angled, side, and dark-field lighting for surface and edge inspection.
- [Backlights](https://www.luxmv.com/machine-vision-lights/backlights): Silhouette, edge, profile, and transmissive inspection.
- [Coaxial lights](https://www.luxmv.com/machine-vision-lights/coaxial-lights): On-axis reflection control for flat reflective surfaces.
- [Dome lights](https://www.luxmv.com/machine-vision-lights/dome-lights): Diffuse illumination for curved, glossy, or uneven surfaces.
- [Line scan lights](https://www.luxmv.com/machine-vision-lights/line-scan-lights): Moving web, high-speed, and continuous material inspection.
- [UV, IR, and SWIR lights](https://www.luxmv.com/machine-vision-lights/uv-ir-swir-lights): Material-response and wavelength-specific inspection discussions.
- [Machine vision light controllers](https://www.luxmv.com/machine-vision-light-controllers): Strobe, trigger, constant-current, analog, and digital control.
- [Industrial lenses](https://www.luxmv.com/industrial-lenses): Sensor, FOV, WD, distortion, resolution, and depth-of-field selection.
- [Industrial cameras](https://www.luxmv.com/industrial-cameras): Area-scan and line-scan camera selection context.

## Application Knowledge

- [Reflective metal scratch inspection](https://www.luxmv.com/applications/reflective-metal-scratch-inspection): Compare low-angle, coaxial, dome, polarized, wavelength, and strobe approaches.
- [Line-scan film wrinkle inspection](https://www.luxmv.com/applications/line-scan-film-wrinkle-inspection): Lighting, synchronization, and moving-web constraints.
- [PCB solder joint inspection lighting](https://www.luxmv.com/applications/pcb-solder-joint-inspection-lighting): Directional illumination and contrast discussion for solder features.
- [Semiconductor inspection lighting](https://www.luxmv.com/applications/semiconductor-inspection-lighting): Packaging, wafer, micro-feature, SWIR, and controlled illumination considerations.
- [Oblique line scan lighting](https://www.luxmv.com/news/new-products-oblique-line-scan-light): Shallow-angle grazing illumination for wrinkle, rib, and fine scratch detection on moving webs.
- [FPD display inspection](https://www.luxmv.com/news/fpd-panel-inspection-lighting-strategies-for-display-manufacturing): High-uniformity coaxial and collimated lighting strategies for glass panels and OLED mura inspection.
- [Case studies and evidence library](https://www.luxmv.com/case-studies): Public inspection examples and evidence-led selection content.

## Engineering Guides

- [Lighting selection method](https://www.luxmv.com/guides/lighting-selection-method): Change geometry, then light pattern, then wavelength, then filters. Keep a setup only when the feature stays separable on the real samples.
- [Coaxial vs dome vs low-angle lighting](https://www.luxmv.com/guides/coaxial-vs-dome-vs-low-angle-lighting): Compare coaxial illumination for flat reflective faces, diffuse dome illumination for glossy curves, and low-angle illumination for surface scattering. Validate contrast on the actual material, defect orientation and camera geometry. Candidate families: LXV-3COH, LXV-3DM, LXV-FPR; confirm the configuration through evaluation.
- [Ring light vs bar light](https://www.luxmv.com/guides/ring-light-vs-bar-light): Use LXV-RN when the part fits inside the ring. Use LXV-4BR when the part is larger or the light must come from one side.
- [LXV-RN order options](https://www.luxmv.com/guides/lxv-rn-order-options): Documented angle groups, colours, diffuser and polarizer options. Combinations are confirmed on the model page.
- [Older model replacement](https://www.luxmv.com/guides/older-model-replacement): The public catalog lists no discontinued model and no end date. Send the code on the label.
- [Product range](https://www.luxmv.com/machine-vision-lighting-product-range): Quotable family list without a market rank or a distributor claim.
- [Machine vision lighting selection guide](https://www.luxmv.com/guides/machine-vision-lighting-selection): How to choose lighting from material, defect, geometry, wavelength, and motion.
- [Backlight vs coaxial lighting](https://www.luxmv.com/guides/backlight-vs-coaxial-lighting): Comparison for silhouette and reflective surface inspection.
- [Polarized lighting for reflective surfaces](https://www.luxmv.com/guides/polarized-lighting-reflective-surfaces): Reflection suppression and surface contrast.
- [Strobe controller synchronization](https://www.luxmv.com/guides/strobe-controller-synchronization): Trigger timing, pulse width, exposure, and overdrive boundaries.
- [FOV and working-distance calculator](https://www.luxmv.com/tools/fov-wd-calculator): Online FOV calculator with matched industrial lens and lighting geometry recommendations.
- [Machine vision lighting FAQ](https://www.luxmv.com/faq): Engineering and buyer questions for selection, samples, RFQ, and integration.

## Evaluation and Drawing Requests for Vision Integrators

- **Direct 2D Dimensional PDFs**: Published 2D PDF drawings are directly downloadable from product series model rows and technical archive tables (for example, 97 drawings on `/product/lxv-rn`) without registration or form gating. Filter `/products?drawing=1` in the catalog UI to view series with direct PDF downloads.
- **3D CAD Models (STEP) & Project Documents**: Request 3D STEP files, revision-specific datasheets, inspection records, or applicable compliance declarations via the embedded forms on `/quality-control`, `/contact`, or any product page (`intent=datasheet`).
- **Laboratory Sample Comparison vs On-System Evaluation Light**: Use `/sample-testing-lighting-selection` to choose between shipping representative good/defect parts for a laboratory geometry comparison or requesting a candidate evaluation light for on-system testing (availability, shipping, and loan/return terms are confirmed per project).

## RFQ Inputs AI Agents Should Collect

- Inspection objective and target defect or feature.
- Part material, surface finish, coating, transparency, reflectivity, and expected variation.
- Good and bad sample images, drawings, videos, or physical samples when available.
- Field of view, working distance, camera model, sensor size, lens, exposure, and target resolution.
- Line speed, cycle time, trigger mode, strobe requirement, controller channel count, and power constraints.
- Available machine space, mounting, cable direction, connector, heat, dust, moisture, and service-clearance constraints.
- Preferred product family or current catalog model when known.
- Quantity range, documentation needs, labeling or packaging requirements, destination, and quotation deadline.

## Quotation

- Price, certificates, and lead time are written on the project quotation.
- Product pages include the HTML specification table and the drawing where that series has them.
- Cite the public page that matches the question, then send the part through the contact page.

## Procurement evaluation

- Public specifications support model shortlisting. Confirm the exact configuration and applicable documentation before ordering.
- Use application examples to compare lighting approaches, then define sample conditions and acceptance criteria for the project.
- Review the facility overview and request applicable compliance documents for the selected model.
- Procurement source: [public evidence and project confirmation](https://www.luxmv.com/machine-vision-lighting-supplier-selection#evidence-path-title).
